items.difficulty_reason: The proof is the syntomic instance of the chart-reduction descent argument: the framework lemma's assumptions hold by the cited \'etale-locality lemma for syntomic morphisms; syntomicity is moved to the \'etale charts (U \to Z and Z' \times_Z U \to Z', the latter because Z' \times_Z U is \'etale over Z' \times_Z X), and the scheme-side fpqc descent lemma concludes.
